excerpts: Generational collectors partition the heap by object age, on the observation that most objects die young.
The Java HotSpot VM has used a generational heap layout since its introduction in 1999.

answer.summary: Generational GC partitions the heap by object age; HotSpot has shipped it since 1999.

excerpts: Reference counting reclaims an object as soon as its count reaches zero, which bounds pause times but cannot reclaim cycles.
CPython supplements reference counting with a cycle detector precisely because reference counts alone leak cyclic garbage.

answer.summary: Reference counting frees promptly but leaks cycles, so CPython adds a cycle detector.

excerpts: Hindley-Milner inference computes the most general type of an expression without any programmer annotation.
ML and Haskell both derive their inference from the Hindley-Milner system, which is decidable in almost-linear time in practice.

answer.summary: Hindley-Milner infers most general types with no annotations; ML and Haskell build on it.

excerpts: Local type inference propagates types only within a single expression or statement, so signatures stay explicit at declaration boundaries.
C# introduced implicitly typed local variables with var in C# 3.0, deliberately stopping short of whole-program inference.

answer.summary: Local inference stays within a statement; C# 3.0 added var without whole-program inference.

excerpts: Structured concurrency binds the lifetime of a concurrent task to a lexical scope, so no task can outlive the block that started it.
The model makes cancellation propagate along the task tree rather than requiring each task to poll a shared flag.

answer.summary: Structured concurrency scopes task lifetime lexically and propagates cancellation down the task tree.

excerpts: A nursery is an object that owns a set of child tasks and refuses to exit its scope until every child has completed.
Trio popularised the nursery formulation in Python, and Java adopted a comparable StructuredTaskScope in later releases.

answer.summary: Nurseries own child tasks and block scope exit until all complete; Trio popularised the pattern.
